M-1: closed — the rate-reduction hold now binds only while the other loan's benefit has no end date recorded or an end date on or after that loan's next due date, so a benefit with no graduated-return due date stops holding the offer once the servicemember certifies, and in every other reachable world a write in this difficulty lifts it.
O-12: closed — the graduated-return policy now also schedules the line for a covered next due date at the plan installment, so the line that lifts the rate-reduction hold is always governed by the declared policy.
O-13: closed — the previous line's amount takes every line on the latest due date together and is held to the larger of the plan and pre-plan installments, so same-day ties no longer depend on row order.
O-14: closed — the settlement rule now states the outcome when the other loan's pending reduced-payment request cannot be offered: only the hardship desk's base decline lifts the wait, so the settlement request is handed to the hardship desk instead of being priced in that contact.
Hold sweep: closed — every hold, wait and prerequisite sentence was checked against every reachable world and the base decision windows; each is either met, lifted by a write available in the same contact, or carries a stated outcome.
